stage0044a_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$ブライト$$
「If even you head off to the battlefield,
　what happens to your mother and Chammy?」

stage0044a_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$ブライト$$
「I didn't let you play with the simulator
　so you could pull a stunt like that」

stage0044a_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Did you want to see $$クェス$$, $$ハサウェイ$$?」

stage0044a_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「I'm going to bring $$クェス$$ back!」

stage0044a_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$クェス$$'s overly sensitive talent
　is being exploited by $$シャア$$.
　It's no use」

stage0044a_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Her talent's being enhanced,
　reduced to nothing but $$シャア$$'s tool...」

stage0044a_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「I'll stop that myself, I swear!」

stage0044a_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ブライト$$
「That's enough, $$ハサウェイ$$!
　You're...」

stage0044a_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$カツ$$
「Wait, Captain $$ブライト$$!
　I'll look after Hasa!」

stage0044a_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$カツ$$
「Please!
　I'll protect $$ハサウェイ$$!
　So...!」

stage0044a_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$ブライト$$
「...Don't make your mother cry」

stage0044a_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$カツ$$
「But the situation's tougher than you think.
　...A girl convinced someone understands her...
　falls hard for him, especially an older man...」

stage0044a_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$カツ$$
「I get it...
　Chase after a girl like that, and all
　that waits for you is grief you can't undo...」

stage0044a_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$カツ$$
「So, no matter what...
　let's get $$クェス$$ back from $$シャア$$」

stage0044a_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$アムロ$$
（The kids I saw in $$カツ$$ and $$ハサウェイ$$ have grown up...
　$$ブライト$$ and I barely have a role left to play...）

stage0044a_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$アムロ$$
（$$シャア$$...
　don't think you can bend $$クェス$$ to your will, too）

stage0044a_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$n
「... All right, everyone...
　we're starting on peeling potatoes for dinner now.」

stage0044a_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Huh...?
　Wasn't $$カミーユ$$ on meal duty today...?」

stage0044a_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$甲児$$
「That $n...
　forced a sim duel on $$カミーユ$$,
　and got wrecked for it」

stage0044a_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$甲児$$
「So, as payment for losing,
　I'm covering his meal duty now」

stage0044a_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Mr. $$カミーユ$$'s on a roll lately.
　I doubt anyone could beat him」

stage0044a_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$甲児$$
「But still, 0 wins in 10 straight.
　I go through the training with him each time,
　wish he'd have put up more of a fight」

stage0044a_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$n
「...$$甲児$$... that ramming tactic you taught me...
　it didn't work at all」

stage0044a_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$甲児$$
「Of course.
　Against $$カミーユ$$ piloting the Zeta,
　even a Rocket Punch is next to impossible to land」

stage0044a_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$宗介$$
「You should have used what I taught you,
　close the distance, then open fire」

stage0044a_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$n
「I tried it.
　...ended up easy pickings for a beam saber」

stage0044a_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$宗介$$
「In your case, you're one step short on the approach.
　You know firsthand that a half measure of distance
　is the most dangerous」

stage0044a_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$n
「...I've got nothing to say to that...」

stage0044a_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「I always figured everyone in $c
　was a genius pilot like Mr. $$アムロ$$...
　but...」

stage0044a_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「So you really do train properly」

stage0044a_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$宗介$$
「Naturally, $$ハサウェイ$$.
　One who can't fight in training can't fight for real」

stage0044a_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$宗介$$
「This $n's combat experience
　is bottom class within $c,
　but managing it is the fruit of daily training」

stage0044a_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$n
「$$ハサウェイ$$... if you're up for it,
　I'll spar with you in a simulation」

stage0044a_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Um... shouldn't we peel potatoes first?」

stage0044a_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$$正太郎$$'s right.
　If you want to train, let's get peeling first」

stage0044a_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$n
「...this feels like backwards priorities for a pilot,
　but it can't be helped...」

stage0044a_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Whatever, but seriously,
　why are us pilots cooking in the hangar?」

stage0044a_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Apparently $$ラー・カイラム$$'s auto-cooker is broken.
　So since we needed somewhere a lot of people
　could work at once, we ended up in the hangar」

stage0044a_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$アンディ$$
「But that's a huge amount.
　$$正太郎$$... can't your $$鉄人$$ handle it somehow?」

stage0044a_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$正太郎$$
「No way.
　Even $$鉄人$$ can't manage such fine work」

stage0044a_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Then, $$タケル$$... what about your psychic powers?」

stage0044a_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$タケル$$
「I think your Digging Force is better suited for it」

stage0044a_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$n
「Don't worry, $$アンディ$$.
　For amateurs like you,
　we've brought in a special instructor today」

stage0044a_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$谷川$$
「All right, everyone!
　I'll teach you how to peel potatoes」

stage0044a_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$谷川$$
「Like this, like this... and done!
　Easy, right?」

stage0044a_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$谷川$$
「Heh heh... cooking's one of my strong suits」

stage0044a_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ジン$$
（Unbelievable...
　guess you can't judge a book by its cover...）

stage0044a_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Heh... stare at a woman's face that hard
　and you'll invite unwanted misunderstandings」

stage0044a_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$$ジン$$!
　What are you doing!?」

stage0044a_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ジン$$
「S-sorry...!
　I... I forgot I had a knife in my hand...」

stage0044a_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$!
　Get to the infirmary, quick!!」

stage0044a_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「No need to worry.
　Not in my case」

stage0044a_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「That's just how I'm built.
　...be more careful from now on, $$ジン$$」

stage0044a_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$ジン$$
（What kind of body is that...
　way too amazing, $$レア・イグラー$$!）

stage0044a_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$マオ$$
「Peeling potatoes, huh...
　Real rookie work, I approve!」

stage0044a_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$マオ$$
「So, $n... got any snacks to go with a drink?」

stage0044a_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$n
「...go eat some potato sprouts or something」

stage0044a_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$マオ$$
「Ha ha ha!
　You got one over on the Boss!」

stage0044a_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$$ジン$$-kun～
　Still gettin' along with our $$シンジ$$-chan?
　$$アスカ$$'s not bullying you, is she～?」

stage0044a_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$マオ$$
「It's fine, Colonel Katsuragi～.
　$$ジン$$'s got $$ユノハ$$～」

stage0044a_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Kids these days sure grow up fast!
　Flirting with a girlfriend on a warship...」

stage0044a_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Now, now, both of you...
　Just because it's personal time doesn't mean
　you can drink this much」

stage0044a_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Whaaat～?
　Is Miss $$スズネ$$ lecturing us～?」

stage0044a_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$マオ$$
「We haven't drunk that much, not that much...
　Just about a dozen canned beers between us～?」

stage0044a_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$スズネ$$
「That is plenty too much!
　Look, you're scaring $$ジン$$!」

stage0044a_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Sorry about that～, $$ジン$$.
　Take care of $$シンジ$$-chan for me～」

stage0044a_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$ミサト$$
「If you make him cry,
　big sis here won't forgive you～」

stage0044a_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$ジン$$
（To think a capable ops commander and squad leader
　could get this out of hand...）

stage0044a_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$クラン$$
「Come to think of it, this is the first time
　you've seen me in Zentradi form」

stage0044a_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$クラン$$
「It's fine.
　I'm not about to step on you」

stage0044a_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$ジン$$
（I thought she was tiny and short,
　so how does she end up growing this big!?）

stage0044a_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$ジン$$
（Way too huge, $$レア・イグラー$$!）

stage0044a_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$ジン$$
（Makes no sense, $$レア・イグラー$$s!）

stage0044a_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$シンジ$$
「That's rare...
　for Ayanami to speak to someone on her own」

stage0044a_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I bet Ayanami's curious about you too, $$ジン$$」

stage0044a_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Not you, $$シンジ$$.
　It's the new guy over there I want」

stage0044a_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$カイエン$$
「I'll get straight to it.
　Who are you, really?」

stage0044a_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$ジン$$
「My name's Akbarjin Badbayar.
　I'm an Element cadet, as you already know」

stage0044a_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$カイエン$$
「I wonder about that...
　If you hacked into Neo-DEAVA's computers,
　you could falsify the data」

stage0044a_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$ジン$$
「I thought my suspicion had already been cleared」

stage0044a_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$シンジ$$
「That's right, Mr. $$カイエン$$.
　$$ジン$$'s even awakened his Element power」

stage0044a_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$カイエン$$
「...but my nightmare keeps going...」

stage0044a_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$シンジ$$
「You mean... your Element ability, Mr. $$カイエン$$...」

stage0044a_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Despair Foresight...
　It's making me dream of a one-eyed giant」

stage0044a_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$カイエン$$
「I don't know what it's foretelling,
　but I can't think of any cause besides your arrival」

stage0044a_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Answer me, $$ジン$$...!
　Aren't you really no Element cadet at all,
　but a spy for the enemy!」

stage0044a_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$ジン$$
「And here I thought you'd say something,
　but it's something that stupid...」

stage0044a_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$タケル$$
「Stop doubting your comrades, $$カイエン$$」

stage0044a_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$カイエン$$
「I never thought of this guy as a comrade」

stage0044a_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Even so, this can't be forgiven!」

stage0044a_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$カイエン$$
「...someday, I'll find proof, without fail」

stage0044a_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Amazing, $$正太郎$$.
　Not backing down an inch against Mr. $$カイエン$$」

stage0044a_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$正太郎$$
「It's nothing like that.
　I just did what I believed was right」

stage0044a_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Hey, $$正太郎$$!
　It's an emergency!」

stage0044a_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「$c got a call from Dr. $$敷島$$.
　He wants us to lend a hand」
